object.body:
Dear $__recipient.name,

This email is to inform you that automatic revocation was enabled on $campaign.campaignName. All records which qualify for revocation were revoked successfully.

Campaign revocation details can be found here: View Campaign Details

Thank you,
The SailPoint Team

This is an automatic message sent to you by Data Access Security - Please do not reply.
